We had a fantastic day at Catch! We had a lounge right on the edge next to the beach and from the get go, the service was wonderfully, the DJ vibes were just right all day and the facilities were great.

Throughout the day there was a sax player and dancers who added to the fun atmosphere and all the meals we had and cocktails were fantastic.

The fire dancers at the end of the night were wonderful, they weren’t on the beach but rather on the decking amongst everyone.

Shout out to Mark who was lovely and gave us plenty of recommendations of places to see in Phuket. When we told him it was our honeymoon trip, he even organised a little cake and sparkler to celebrate.

Ps; sunset was spectacular!!

Amazing views, great cocktails, delicious food. Best spot for sunset drinks/dinner. Bo Bo looked after us very well and always made sure our drinks were topped up. The pizzas are freshly made in a pizza oven. Best sunset we’ve ever seen. We visited in low season on Friday & Monday and had no issue walking in without reservations.

We visited about a month ago and had an amazing day. We booked a pool sunbed and it was absolutely worth it. The food was delicious, the staff were friendly and attentive and the whole atmosphere was just perfect. We were lucky with beautiful weather too, which made our day even better.

Catch Beach Club is a must try if you are in the Bang Tao area. Food, drinks, Atmosphere all first class. An extensive menu covering all your favorites as well as cocktails that would keep you sipping all day. For a completely chic experience I would highly recommend. Book your sunbed or Cabana in advance. I went with my family and it was perfect for both my wife and son.

Catch Beach Club honestly feels like the ultimate place to be here. The atmosphere is absolutely stunning — directly by the ocean with the sound of the waves just a few meters away, beautiful lighting everywhere, and an overall vibe that instantly makes you feel relaxed and comfortable.

The staff was extremely friendly and attentive, and the entire place gives you exactly what you would hope for from a high-end beach club experience. Yes, it is definitely on the more expensive side, but you are clearly paying for the incredible ambiance and location, and in that sense it feels worth it.

The music was perfect for the setting: relaxed, stylish, and never too much. It’s exactly the kind of place where you genuinely enjoy spending hours without wanting to leave.

The only small downside — and honestly not really the club’s fault — was that it deserved a few more people. At times it felt a little empty, but that was probably because we visited during the week rather than on a weekend.

Overall, a beautiful beach club with an amazing atmosphere, great service, and one of the best seaside vibes we’ve experienced in Phuket.
Amazing spot on the beach to have lunch. Fans blowing kept the humidity down and bugs away. Absolutely fantastic food.

What an amazing beach club in Phuket! Thanks to all the staff for their excellent service, especially View and Mark. The atmosphere is fantastic, and the food is delicious. Definitely worth visiting again—I’ll be back!
The best sunset views with a bar overlooking the sea. Great for sunbathing, with sunbeds on the sand and in a few areas by two pools. Good food menu and excellent music, day and night.

Highly recommended if you’re looking to enjoy an intimate dinner with a loved one or simply a special time with family. Catch Beach Club caters to all kinds of occasions! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Very busy and lively. Service could have matched the atmosphere but it was a bit off. Still a good vibe and great entertainment. The food itself was ok but the drinks were fire!

an awesome sunday brunch @ this beach club ... the buffet brunch included foie gras , fresh oysters , several roasts , various boat noodles , lovely salads , loafs of deserts , pizzas , pastas ... the list goes on ... all of this right by the beach ...

You definitely need to make a reservation before coming here! The restaurant was extremely busy on Sunday — fully packed everywhere 😅

If you prefer à la carte dining, it’s better to go to the restaurant next door
Cool place to watch sunset. Relaxing vibe. Good place to be if you wanna chill and relax with best music beat.

This place is just fantastic. I go there quite often and even have a member card now. Both Pool areas are great, the staff is attentive, areas are clean. The food is always good and the Sunday brunch is amazing as well as the Friday Dinner Buffet. The selection offered is always good and the food is fresh and of good quality. The DJ's are always excellent but this of course is a matter of taste. You'll be happy if you like electronic music mostly. Ibiza style atmosphere. I'm a bit sensible with noise but never had the feeling that the music is uncomfortably loud. Always appropriate for each time in the day. As a member you get many benefits and it's really worth it. So happy to be part of the family )) I simply love this place. Thank you for always and consistently giving me a good experience for over 2 years now. I appreciate that so much.

This beach bar is great for sundowners. Easy access directly to the beach makes it better.

A good selection of food and drinks makes your day complete.

The service is mostly good and erratic at times. The music and the sound system was good and we had a great time there.

We visited Catch Beach Club for brunch and ended up staying for dinner as well. For brunch, we booked a sunbed for 5,000 baht, which can be used as a deposit for food and drinks.

The atmosphere was great, lively and relaxed, with a lounge DJ playing during the day and evening. There was also a small fire performance with artists walking around, although there was no big fire show during dinner. It is a nice place to spend the whole day: enjoy the beach, pool, shower, relax, and then stay for dinner.

For brunch, we tried the gazpacho. The presentation was beautiful, served with shrimp, but the taste itself felt a little flat. The scallop ceviche with shrimp was excellent and I definitely recommend it. The mashed potatoes with truffle were also delicious. I almost licked the plate twice. The blue crab salad has been on the menu for a long time, but as always, it was tasty.

For dinner, the pad thai was amazing, juicy, flavorful, and very well made. We also tried the octopus, but for me it was too spicy, so keep in mind that it is above medium spice level.

The coffee was good. Beer selection could be better, especially on tap. Most options were bottled, and I think a place like this would benefit from a few draft beer choices. I also wanted fresh juice by the glass, but they only had large 1.5 liter fresh juice options, while the rest were from cartons.

They now have two pools around the beach club area, which is a nice upgrade. Overall, it is a very good place to spend the whole day when the weather is sunny.

My favorite beach-club in Bang Tao.
In a day time, evening party, Friday or Sunday BBQ.
Food is always good, virgin pina colada is the best in town (I swear) and the vibe is just incredible.
Performances, entertainment and great fun vibe.

Recommend to visit
Perfect place! Perfect food! Perfect staff and perfect decoration! What else?! ❤️🤩🥳 Always enjoying every moments at the Catch Club Phuket!!! 🇹🇭❤️
Great beach club, beautiful vibes, and professional service. The team works hard with guests from all over the world — stay strong and keep smiling. You’re doing an amazing job.

Catch Beach Club is about a 35–45 minute drive from Patong, depending on traffic. The location is undeniably scenic, especially with its stunning beachfront view, making it a nice spot for a chilled-out afternoon.

The venue itself is stylish but relatively small, with two swimming pools — one reserved for adults only, and another open to everyone, including families. It’s a cozy setup, but can feel a bit crowded during peak times.

The beach view is gorgeous, but unfortunately, the ocean water is not clean. It was disappointing to see plastic bags and bottles floating around, which really takes away from the overall experience. Definitely not a place you’d want to swim.

On the plus side, the drink selection is solid, offering a wide variety at reasonable prices. It’s a good spot to relax with a cocktail in hand.

However, the food was a major letdown. We sampled a large part of the menu, and most dishes arrived cold and underwhelming. The only decent item was the pizza, which was just okay — so they get a point for that.

We stayed until sunset and left after it got completely dark, and surprisingly, the entire pool area was extremely poorly lit. We had to use our phone flashlights to find our belongings, and no staff came to assist or check in, which felt careless given the upscale image they try to project.

To top it off, we spent a bit over 25,000 THB in just about 3.5 hours, which left us feeling like the experience did not match the price tag.

Overall: A beautiful setting for drinks and sunset views, but the lackluster food, poor service after dark, and dirty beach take away from what could be a premium beach club experience.

Booking a sunbed is quite difficult. There is online or website booking always fully and some problem with system, so without a reservation it can be inconvenient to get a sunbed. We had to wait at the bar, but luckily we got one within 5 minutes.

Catch beach club is fantastic. From the friendly staff, the fabulous music to the delicious food, this place was one of our favourite places in Phuket.
Special mentions to their breakfast, which is included if you travel with Luxury Escapes.
Also, We didn’t know anything about the Sunday brunch, but thank goodness we accidentally arrived that morning just in time for it (12noon - 3pm). More lunchtime than brunch, but anyway, who cares! The food was incredible.
The only thing I didn’t love was the Thai beef salad. Loads of celery and not much else.

One thing to note is that if you are traveling with Luxury Escapes, you will be choosing from a limited menu (both food and cocktails). It wasn’t a problem because the food was also delicious, but we just didn’t realise about the limited menu that before we booked.

I visited on a Sunday around 4:00 p.m. as a solo diner while traveling. I regularly review restaurants and beach clubs on my social media, so I was looking forward to experiencing this one.
Unfortunately, I did not feel welcome from the moment I arrived.
I asked for a table for one and was told food service hadn’t started yet and that only bar seating was available. When I said I was happy to wait for a table, I was reminded multiple times about the minimum spend, even after I had already agreed to it. It felt like I was being talked out of dining rather than welcomed as a guest.
What stood out most was that my reservation was simply written on a yellow sticky note. Whether that is standard practice or not, it came across as dismissive and very unprofessional.
Combined with the overall interaction, it left me feeling like my business wasn’t valued.
I decided to leave before ordering and spend my dollars elsewhere.
This experience was especially disappointing because I took my business to another beach club that provided exceptional service!
Even when someone in my group repeatedly asked for drinks to be remade, the staff remained patient, accommodating, and genuinely welcoming. That is what hospitality should look like. I included the pictures here.

I review restaurants and beach clubs for my audience across social media, and I share both positive and negative experiences honestly.
This is one of the few places where I walked away before even having the chance to order because It simply wasn’t welcoming.
